items.title: Gucci watchmaking division cuts 30 jobs in Switzerland
items.summary: Gucci Swiss Timepieces is cutting 30 of 95 posts at its Cortaillod factory in Neuchatel as logistics functions move to Trecate, Italy; consultation runs to December 4. Unia union rep Solenn Ochsner said haute horlogerie repositioning 'cannot be improvised' and flagged real employment impact across the sector -- the second redundancy round in two years after ~20 cuts in 2025.

items.title: Gucci watchmaking division cuts 30 jobs in Switzerland
items.summary: Wire-syndicated follow-up confirming the Cortaillod job cuts and Italy logistics consolidation; positions the move within Gucci's wider cost-discipline push under Kering's ReconKering turnaround plan, adding financial-wire corroboration to the labor story.

items.title: Gucci price cuts break luxury's biggest taboo; Louis Vuitton isn't following
items.summary: Analytical piece on Gucci's up-to-30% price cuts (Padlock bag from EUR3,500 to EUR2,450 in France) framed as a 'price architecture reset'; notes Gucci acknowledged prior increases outran willingness to pay, while Louis Vuitton pursues a 'ladder down' entry-price strategy instead of cuts -- Gucci bears the reputational risk alone among top houses.

items.title: Why discounts, store closures may not be enough for Gucci as China's luxury slowdown bites
items.summary: Independent-judgment analysis arguing Gucci's price cuts and accelerated store closures address symptoms, not the structural China-led demand slowdown; questions whether discounting further erodes brand desirability without a clearer product/creative fix. Retained for the Kering-group pricing debate central to EU trade coverage this week.

items.title: The 2026 Christmas campaigns are all about star power
items.summary: Roundup covering Gucci's Mariah Carey-fronted, Harmony Korine-directed 'Gucci Gift' film showcasing the Butterfly capsule; descriptive, admiring-but-not-evaluative treatment within a wider celebrity-led festive-campaign trend alongside Prada and Dior -- activation coverage, scored 0 per the activation-discount rule.

items.title: Hailey Bieber's sheer lace Gucci dress for Vogue France
items.summary: Celebrity-styling writeup praising Hailey Bieber's Gucci sheer lace embroidered dress, fur coat and statement earrings for a Vogue France shoot; fan comments quoted ('Beautiful Hailey!', 'Ate it up') are enthusiastic but directed mainly at the celebrity/stylist rather than an independent brand verdict -- treated as mild activation-adjacent positive.

items.title: La divisione orologi di Gucci taglia 30 posti di lavoro in Svizzera
items.summary: Italian-language trade report on the Cortaillod watch-division job cuts, framing it within Kering CEO Luca de Meo's broader cost-rationalization program (84 store closures in H1 2026, wholesale network rationalization, Kering Beauty sold to L'Oreal) aimed at reducing group debt while funding the Gucci turnaround.

items.title: Les news mode qui font parler en novembre 2026
items.summary: French fashion-news roundup mentioning Gucci's Mariah Carey holiday campaign among the month's talked-about stories alongside Balenciaga and Jude Bellingham items; brief, descriptive mention with no independent verdict on Gucci specifically.

items.title: Gucci sparks backlash after using AI models for Milan Fashion Week campaign
items.summary: Report on backlash to Gucci's AI-generated imagery for the Primavera campaign; critics called it 'AI slop' and said it contradicted the house's craftsmanship values, while some defenders called the visuals 'stunning' regardless of AI use. Outside the 14-day freshness window but retained only as background context, not counted toward today's freshness quota.

items.title: X post: "Gucci cuts prices on select merchandise by up to 30%..."
items.summary: Viral-style X/Twitter post summarizing Gucci's price cuts after '13 straight quarters of declining sales' while Louis Vuitton stays firm; framed with a skeptical '👀' emoji suggesting watchful/critical reader reaction to the discounting move. Organic SNS commentary, not brand-issued.

items.title: What is the 'Gucci Morty' meme?
items.summary: Viral ironic meme pairing a Rick and Morty character with Gucci branding, spreading from Instagram to X and TikTok as an 'aura' joke format; brand mention is incidental to meme culture rather than brand evaluation -- neutral buzz/volume signal, not a product or policy opinion.

items.title: Gucci quality concerns (PurseForum thread, active)
items.summary: Active community thread where members debate current Gucci leather-goods QC, citing hardware-finish fading and inconsistent stitching on recent purchases versus peers like Hermes and Prada; organic consumer-level quality scrutiny independent of brand messaging.

items.title: Forum members review the 'vulgar' Gucci Spring 2027 collection from Demna
items.summary: Fashion-forum members' roundup reviewing Demna's Spring 2027 Gucci collection; aggregated community reaction is sharply divided, with some calling the collection 'vulgar' and lacking vision while others praised its boldness -- a decided-but-mixed thesis, magnitude capped per the dominant-thesis rubric.

items.summary: UK community thread mocking mispronunciation of the Gucci name in a lighthearted AIBU (Am I Being Unreasonable) post; mostly comedic/neutral brand-adjacent chatter with no clear evaluative stance on the brand itself.
